description.value:
New Heritage (v2). Cro-Magnon replaces Erectus in the Human heritage lineup.

“Humanity is the species that keeps walking even when the map says ‘stop.’”

Human (Cro-Magnon). You are not a fantasy human. You are the cognitive, symbolic, cooperative inheritance of the lineage that first painted ancestors on cave walls, buried its dead with flowers, and traded ochre across a continent it had no map for.

Where Neanderthal is strength and Florensis is reach, Cro-Magnon is pattern. Language, ritual, coalition. You are the human branch that kept explaining things until the explanation started working.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid.
  • Size. Medium.
  • Speed. 30 feet.
  • Lineage Lean. Your lineage leans toward INT or CHA—expressed through Tier powers.

Core: Stubborn Spark

At creation you gain Stubborn Spark (Adaptive, Tenacious, Lineage Memory).

Cro-Magnon Tier Powers

You gain Tier I at creation, then Tier II (5), Tier III (11), Tier IV (17). Cro-Magnon powers emphasize: Symbolic Thought (ritual and language sensitivity), Coalition Instinct (cooperation bonuses with allies), Tool Mind (improvisational tool use), and Narrative Memory (lore retention that persists across generations).

Note: This heritage uses placeholder ItemGrant UUIDs. Run the Human wiring macro after you store feats/species in compendiums.
